title: Version 0.122.0: Enhanced TUI, Plugin Workflows, and Security Improvements
description: Codex CLI 0.122.0 released on April 20, 2026, featuring standalone installer improvements, TUI enhancements with `/side` conversations, tabbed plugin browsing, and filesystem permission controls with deny-read policies.

title: Version 2.1.76 with MCP Enhancements and Multi-Repository Context
description: Claude Code released version 2.1.76 with enhanced Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities, improved VS Code integration, and a new multi-repository context window. Additionally, Claude Opus 4.7 was released, improving software engineering capabilities and autonomous work handling.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Max feels 'unlimited' compared to Cursor's throttling
Benchmark testing from early April 2026 showed Claude Code as a winner on code quality

title: Pricing Update to $15/month and $120/year
description: Claude Code updated pricing to $15/month and $120/year for certain tiers on April 16th.

community_feedback.quote: Discussion about 'Is Claude Code 5x Cheaper Than Cursor?' comparing Claude Max at $100/mo vs Cursor Pro+ at $60/mo

title: Codex Becomes Broader Workspace Tool with In-App Browser and Computer Use
description: Codex announced major updates on April 16, 2026, including an in-app browser for page commenting, Computer Use for macOS app automation, thread automations, task sidebar, pull request workflow integration, and artifact viewer.

title: April 2026 Updates: Claude Opus 4.7 GA, Copilot Cloud Agent, and Enhanced Security
description: GitHub released multiple Copilot updates in April 2026, including Claude Opus 4.7 general availability, Copilot cloud agent with research/plan/code capabilities, Copilot CLI auto model selection, data residency options (US + EU), and FedRAMP compliance.

title: Security Incident: Source Code Leak via npm Registry
description: Claude Code's source code was accidentally leaked via a source map file left in Anthropic's npm registry, revealing prompt injection vulnerabilities that raised security concerns.

community_feedback.quote: Source code leak revealed prompt injection vulnerabilities

title: Version 0.121.0: Marketplace, Memory Mode, and MCP Expansions
description: Codex CLI 0.121.0 released on April 15, 2026, adding marketplace command, TUI prompt history improvements, memory mode controls, expanded MCP/plugin support with Apps tool calls, and secure devcontainer profile.

title: Cursor 3.1 Released with Enhanced Agents Window
description: Cursor released version 3.1 on April 13, 2026, featuring a tiled layout for the Agents Window, upgraded voice input, and keyboard fixes including improved Cmd+Delete handling, Vim keybindings, and Ctrl modifier combinations.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is noted as the 'most widely used AI coding tool among individual developers' based on community surveys
Some developers reported throttling issues with Cursor

title: Model Availability Update
description: Codex announced model availability changes on April 7, 2026, removing gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1, and gpt-5, while keeping gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.3-codex, and gpt-5.2 available.
